Global Medical Device Manufacturers
B. Braun Medical Industries
: Operates a massive manufacturing and regional competence center in Penang, producing surgical instruments, intravenous access, and infusion therapy devices.
Boston Scientific
: Runs advanced manufacturing operations in Penang focused on less-invasive cardiovascular and endoscopy medical devices.
Medtronic
: Maintains a strong operational and manufacturing footprint supporting high-tech medical technology and patient care solutions.
Abbott

Smith & Nephew
: Operates high-tech orthopedic and advanced wound-care manufacturing plants out of Penang.
Dexcom
: Manufactures innovative continuous glucose monitoring systems from major facilities in Penang.
Stryker Corporation
: Supplies and supports advanced surgical, orthopedic, and neurotechnology medical equipment.
